announcements.title: Core Committee & Domain Wing Recruitment Drive 2026-27 Announced
announcements.summary: IntelliGenZ is opening applications for Technical, Design, Event Management, and Media Wings for the upcoming academic year.
announcements.content:
The Department of CSE (AIML) & AI at Dr. K. V. Subba Reddy Institute of Technology proudly invites enthusiastic students to apply for the IntelliGenZ Club Core Committee.

We are recruiting across 5 key wings:
- **Technical Wing:** AI/ML, Full Stack, IoT & Competitive Programming
- **Design Wing:** UI/UX, Graphic Design & Motion Graphics
- **Event Operations:** Logistics, Sponsorship & Stage Coordination
- **Content & Media:** Technical Writing, Photography, Video Editing & Social Media
- **Public Relations:** College outreach & speaker coordination

All 1st, 2nd, and 3rd-year engineering students with a hunger to learn and innovate are encouraged to submit their applications through the online portal before the deadline.
announcements.author: Faculty Coordinator & President

announcements.title: IntelliGenZ Teams Shortlisted for National AI Challenge Grand Finale
announcements.summary: Two teams from CSE (AIML) mentored by IntelliGenZ club faculty have reached the Grand Finale among 400+ nationwide institutions.
announcements.content:
Hearty congratulations to Team 'NeuroPulse' and Team 'VisionGrid' for being selected for the Grand Finale of the National Smart Innovation Challenge!

Their innovative projects on **AI-Driven Crop Disease Diagnosis via Satellite Imaging** and **Smart Traffic Density AI Optimizer** were lauded by the technical jury. The management and faculty of DR. K. V. SUBBA REDDY INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY congratulate the teams.
announcements.author: Head of Department

announcements.title: Inauguration of Dedicated High-Compute AI Research Station in Department
announcements.summary: A brand-new state-of-the-art GPU workstation cluster has been commissioned for club research and student deep learning projects.
announcements.content: With support from college leadership at Dr. K. V. Subba Reddy Institute of Technology, a dedicated high-performance computing environment with NVIDIA RTX accelerators has been set up in Lab 3. Club members working on large language models and computer vision research can now schedule compute slots through the IntelliGenZ portal.

projects.name: RetinaScan AI: Automated Ocular Disease Classifier
projects.short_description: Deep convolutional neural network model detecting diabetic retinopathy and glaucoma from fundus retinal photographs.
projects.description: A collaborative research project built by IntelliGenZ students in partnership with local healthcare clinics. The model achieves 96.4% sensitivity in early-stage diabetic retinopathy detection.

projects.name: KVSRIT Campus Copilot: RAG-Powered AI Student Assistant
projects.short_description: Multilingual conversational AI agent trained on syllabus, college regulations, examination schedules, and departmental notices.
projects.description: An interactive generative AI assistant built using Gemini models and vector search embeddings, serving 2,000+ college students daily for academic queries.

projects.name: EdgeFace: Multi-Camera Real-Time Attendance with Anti-Spoofing
projects.short_description: Ultra-low latency facial recognition kiosk running on edge hardware with 3D liveness detection.
projects.description: Deployed in the department smart seminar halls to automate attendance logging with zero manual friction and real-time dashboard analytics.

projects.name: AgriVision: Autonomous Drone Crop Health Analyzer
projects.short_description: Multispectral drone camera integration with lightweight semantic segmentation for agricultural yield estimation.
projects.description: Student innovation project addressing drought-prone agricultural monitoring in Rayalaseema region with aerial multispectral telemetry.
